regions.today: Dry and bright today with long spells of sunshine, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees in a light, occasionally moderate, south to southeast breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry for most tonight with clear spells. It will turn cloudier in southern parts overnight with patchy rain and drizzle developing towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees, with a light to moderate southeasterly breeze, freshening towards morning.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be windy with southeasterly winds increasing fresh to strong and gusty, reaching near gale force in the evening. Some early bright spells in northern parts but turning cloudy with patchy rain and drizzle. More persistent rain will spread from the southwest later in the afternoon and evening, turning heavy in places with localised flooding possible. A mild and humid day with highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees.
